newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: BANGLADESH TAKA ENDS FIRMER ON POOR DOLLAR DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: BANGLADESH TAKA ENDS FIRMER ON POOR DOLLAR DEMAND.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed firmer on Sunday amid a lack of demand for the dollar because of the weekend in international markets, dealers said.
The local unit finished at 44.2100/2120 to the dollar against the previous close at 44.2200/2300.
The call money rates fell to 4.0-4.5 percent at the close against an opening of 6.5-7.5 percent after the market received a fresh supply of about five billion taka in matured central bank bills.
The previous close was at 8.0-8.5 percent.
